cards.interpretation: Fictional sealed vaults visualise The DAO exploit. A one-way violet stream depicts ETH diverted into the locked child DAO. A small amber loop at the SPLIT control represents recursive calls, not funds returned to The DAO. Enlarged fictional engineers convey urgency. The receiver display references the approximate 27-day withdrawal restriction reported during the attack. No actual physical building, identifiable attacker, Ethereum consensus breach or later July fork is depicted.
